```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```
```{r load-libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(tidycensus)

source(here::here("analysis", "figures.R"))
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 14))
```
```{r load-and-prep}
road_raw <- read_csv(here::here("data", "full_run", "positive_detections.csv"))
alpr_raw <- read_csv(here::here("data", "full_run", "combined_positive_detections.csv")) %>%
  filter(origin == "alpr")

# One row per sampled GSV image (incl. zero detections); see streetview/philly_metadata.py
meta <- read_csv(here::here("data", "philly_meta.csv"))

road_counts <- road_raw %>%
  group_by(panoid, lat, lon) %>%
  summarise(camera_count = n(), .groups = "drop")

df_road <- meta %>%
  select(panoid, lat, lon) %>%
  left_join(road_counts, by = c("panoid", "lat", "lon")) %>%
  mutate(
    camera_count = replace_na(camera_count, 0),
    city         = "Philadelphia"
  )

alpr_counts <- alpr_raw %>%
  group_by(panoid, lat, lon) %>%
  summarise(camera_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(city = "Philadelphia")

city_data <- tibble(
  city                   = "Philadelphia",
  type                   = "US",
  state                  = "PA",
  county                 = "Philadelphia County",
  road_network_length_km = 6089,
  # Implied mean spacing along network so pop_pano = N (see figures.R estimate_detection_metrics);
  # philly_metadata CLI can use --min_spacing 50; default run uses min_spacing=NULL.
  m_per_pano             = 2 * road_network_length_km * 1000 / nrow(meta),
  population_census2010  = 1526006
)
```

## Figure 1 — Sampled locations across Philadelphia
```{r sampled-map, fig.width=8, fig.height=10}
generate_sampled_point_map(df_road, "Philadelphia")
```

## Figure 2 — Detected surveillance cameras
```{r detected-map, fig.width=8, fig.height=10}
generate_detected_point_map(df_road, "Philadelphia")
```

## Figure 3 — Camera density estimate
```{r density}
em <- df_road %>%
  summarise(
    n_pano      = n(),
    n_detection = sum(camera_count)
  ) %>%
  mutate(city = "Philadelphia", period = "2024") %>%
  estimate_detection_metrics()

tibble(
  Metric = c("Detections per km (est.)", "SE", "Total cameras (est.)"),
  Value  = c(
    round(em$est_detections_per_km, 3),
    round(em$se_detections_per_km,  3),
    round(em$est_detections,        0)
  )
) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

## Figure 4 — Demographic correlations
```{r census-join}
df_road_race <- annotate_points_with_census(df_road, "Philadelphia", "race")

df_road_race %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = percentage_minority, y = camera_count)) +
  geom_smooth(
    method  = "lm",
    formula = y ~ poly(x, degree = 2),
    se      = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name   = "Minority share of population (census block group)",
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Detections per image") +
  theme(
    panel.grid   = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line    = element_line(size = 0.5, color = "black")
  )
```
